entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators"), same as lowerSortOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's identical check (histogram_native_mixed_or_sort.go, cerberus issue #2605) and its histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate.go / histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate_presence.go / histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate_count_values.go / histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate_float_only.go / histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate_topk.go siblings. sortByLabelArgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp only ever matches b via mixedExpHistogramSetOp, which requires b.Op == parser.LOR — `or` is a set operator, never a comparison, so the parser can never have set ReturnBool on it.
